data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 demotes reinstatement from a derived guarantee to a merely monitored invariant whose checker can only flag violations post-hoc. The problem statement requires preserving reinstatement as a 'derived property'; a checker that reports violations after acceptance does not preserve reinstatement as a derived property — it instead admits that reinstatement can fail and merely makes the failure observable. This is a weakening of the commitment set the problem explicitly demands be preserved, not an expansion or strengthening of the semantics.
